_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154423 (art), 154641-154650 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants, because the loadout slots are shared and only the NATO model was captured. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Mobile Anti-Air
_alias_note: No "aa" or "anti-air" alias. Both are generic: "Anti-Air Missile" is an attack helicopter secondary, so those forms would pull unrelated lines onto this page.

options.name: High-Velocity
options.title: High Velocity AA Shell
options.description: A quick-firing round effective against fast-moving and lightly armored aircraft. Ineffective against armored ground vehicles.

options.name: Laser-Guided
options.title: Laser-Guided AA Missile
options.description: A highly maneuverable laser-guided surface-to-air missile. Allows proficient users to bypass countermeasures. Guides towards the point of aim.

options.name: Thermal-Blocking
options.title: Thermal-Blocking Smoke
options.description: Discharges a cloud of thermal smoke that obscures the vehicle. Disrupts the guidance systems of incoming lock-on missiles, blocks spotting, and deals moderate damage to enemy infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Systems Upgrade
options.description: Faster cooldowns enabled on all equipment and increased radar range.
